routes.description: Deterministic NExtSEEK pipeline via chat_nextseek (no Claude reasoning loop).
routes.best_for: Structured biomedical sample / project / study queries that map onto chat_nextseek's pipeline.
routes.not_for: File I/O, code execution, free-form reasoning, multi-tool work outside chat_nextseek.

task_families.name: sample_search
example_queries: Find me mice treated with NDMA.
What monkeys exist in the database?
Find me all PBMCs associated with BTC Patients.

task_families.name: lineage_or_graph
task_families.description: Graph traversal: lineage, study membership, assay-on-sample.
example_queries: How many samples are in the GBM study?
What assays were run on study X?

task_families.name: report_generation
task_families.description: Canned biomedical report templates (GEO / SRA / NFCORE / PRIDE).
example_queries: Generate a GEO submission for these samples.
Build an SRA biosample template for study Y.

task_families.name: memory_lookup
task_families.description: Follow-up Q&A against the last result set.
example_queries: What sample types were in those results?

task_families.name: reporter_summary
example_queries: Give me an RPPR summary for SRP.

routes.description: Container Claude Code: full agentic environment with file I/O, code execution, and arbitrary plugins / skills.
routes.best_for: Open-ended reasoning, file I/O, code, multi-tool workflows.
routes.not_for: Pure NExtSEEK lookups that chat_nextseek answers deterministically.

task_families.name: file_io_and_summarization
task_families.description: Read project files mounted at /data/projects, summarize, transform.
example_queries: Walk me through the sample tree extraction pipeline.

task_families.name: code_and_scripts
task_families.description: Write or refactor Python / shell / SQL.
example_queries: Write a Python script that plots age distribution by sex.
Refactor this function to use pathlib.
